correctStatements.text: At 10:00 Winston noticed the revenue dashboard showed $1.84 million for the previous day while finance expected about $0.92 million.
At 10:06 Tamsin observed the figure was exactly double and suspected duplicate rows.
At 10:15 Arjun found that the nightly job ran twice, at 02:00 and again at 02:50 after a retry.
Arjun explained the load step appends rather than upserts, so the retry doubled every row.
Bianca reported two executive reports had gone out that morning with the wrong figure.
At 10:30 Tamsin decided to delete the second batch by run id and re-aggregate the day.
At 10:52 Tamsin finished the dedupe and saw the dashboard show $0.93 million for the previous day.
At 11:05 Bianca sent corrected reports with an apology note.
At 11:10 Winston marked the incident resolved.
Arjun will switch the load step to an idempotent upsert keyed on run date.
Winston will build a row count sanity check against the previous day.
Bianca summarised that a retried non-idempotent load doubled the daily totals and misled two reports for roughly an hour and a half.
